name: orchard
title: Orchard
description: Rewrite and translate selected text with Apple's on-device model, through the Orchard app. Nothing leaves your Mac.
author: iraosandeep

commands.name: rewrite-selection
commands.title: Rewrite Selection
commands.subtitle: Orchard
commands.description: Rewrite the selected text (or the clipboard) with a preset or your own instruction.

commands.name: fix-grammar
commands.title: Fix Grammar
commands.subtitle: Orchard
commands.description: Fix spelling, grammar and punctuation in the selected text and paste the result over it.

commands.name: make-shorter
commands.title: Make Shorter
commands.subtitle: Orchard
commands.description: Make the selected text shorter and paste the result over it.

commands.name: make-formal
commands.title: Make Formal
commands.subtitle: Orchard
commands.description: Make the selected text more formal and paste the result over it.

commands.name: make-friendly
commands.title: Make Friendly
commands.subtitle: Orchard
commands.description: Make the selected text warmer and paste the result over it.

commands.name: translate
commands.title: Translate
commands.subtitle: Orchard
commands.description: Translate the selected text (or the clipboard) into any language.

commands.name: translate-selection
commands.title: Translate Selection
commands.subtitle: Orchard
commands.description: Translate the selected text into your default language and paste the result over it.

preferences.name: translateTo
preferences.title: Translate To
preferences.description: Language to translate into, e.g. English, Hindi or Spanish.

commands.name: install-orchard
commands.title: Install Orchard
commands.subtitle: Orchard
commands.description: Install or update the Orchard app from GitHub.

preferences.name: serverURL
preferences.title: Orchard URL
preferences.description: Where the Orchard app's server listens.
